alias_non_claim: An alias permits row-by-row comparison but never satisfies the canonical public type identity.

abi_adapter_types.name: IFont
abi_adapter_types.obligation: Hidden non-dispatch IFont retains exact HRESULT/out-parameter ABI obligations. Its FUNCDESCs are adapter contracts and must not be compared directly with VBA Property/Get/Let declarations.

direct_facade_types.name: Controls

direct_facade_types.name: Picture
direct_facade_types.obligation: Public supporting object used by MSForms picture-valued properties; its callable and VAR_DISPATCH surface is an implementation obligation, not external ABI plumbing.

member_projection_overrides.name: Render
member_projection_overrides.basis: The final FUNCDESC parameter is pointer(Void), representing a native bounds pointer whose VBA/CalcVBA source lowering is not encoded by the typelib fact pack; require an explicit adapter instead of inventing a source signature.

effective_loader_profiles.exposure_rule: Option Private Module suppresses every module. Otherwise standard modules are exposed; class modules use source VB_Exposed when present and exact basproj VBExposed as the fallback.
effective_loader_profiles.creatable_rule: Source VB_Creatable overrides exact basproj VBCreatable when present; otherwise the basproj value is used. A recognized creatable Instancing value from exact basproj metadata, or from an exported class header when basproj Instancing is absent, also makes the class creatable.

effective_loader_profiles.exposure_rule: The loader supplies vb_exposed=true to every listed module, but an explicit source VB_Exposed value overrides that fallback; standard modules remain exposed regardless, and Option Private Module suppresses exposure for every module kind.
effective_loader_profiles.creatable_rule: The loader supplies vb_creatable=true to every listed module, but an explicit source VB_Creatable value overrides that fallback.

classification_rules.accepted: Every primary FM20/stdole type and member, every explicitly documented host overlay row, and every canonical persistence row is retained.
classification_rules.restricted: Only an exact authoritative restricted flag may make a callable implementation dimension not applicable.
classification_rules.dual_companion: A dual companion remains an exact metadata row but is not a second VBA facade obligation.
classification_rules.alias_typedef: TKIND_ALIAS rows retain exact metadata identity and lower recursively to their canonical VBA source type; they are not class-module obligations.
classification_rules.abi_adapter: A non-dispatch supporting interface retains exact ABI adapter rows and is never compared directly with VBA-facing source signatures.
classification_rules.external_abi: stdole ABI structures, aliases, and IUnknown/IDispatch plumbing remain identity/signature-closure rows; Picture is a supporting-object implementation obligation while IPictureDisp lowers to its Picture alias target.
classification_rules.unexpected_public: Every declared-public CalcForms row not mapped to an accepted contract row is emitted and gates a green result.
